shut down a factory: The company decided to shut down a factory in the south because it had been losing money for years.
這家公司決定關閉南部的一間工廠，因為它多年來一直在虧損。
shut out the noise: I always wear earplugs on the train to shut out the noise and get some sleep before work.
我在火車上總是戴著耳塞來隔絕噪音，好在上班前睡一下。
shut up: Tired of hearing his brother complain all night, Tom finally shouted at him to shut up and let him sleep.
湯姆受夠了整晚聽他弟弟抱怨，最後對他大吼要他閉嘴，讓他睡覺。
shut one's eyes to: The manager cannot shut his eyes to the problem any longer, because customers are complaining every day.
經理不能再對這個問題視而不見了，因為每天都有顧客在抱怨。
shut the door on: The company has not shut the door on further talks, so the workers still hope to reach an agreement.
公司並沒有拒絕進一步的談判，所以工人們仍然希望能達成協議。
shut off the engine: When you stop to fill up the car with gas, you should always shut off the engine first for safety.
當你停下來加油時，為了安全起見，你應該總是先把引擎熄火。
shut out the opponent: Our goalkeeper played so well that we were able to shut out the opponent and win the game three to zero.
我們的守門員表現得非常好，所以我們能讓對手掛零，以三比零贏得比賽。
shuttle between two cities: Because his family lives in Tainan, the engineer has to shuttle between two cities every weekend by high-speed rail.
因為他的家人住在台南，這位工程師每個週末都得搭高鐵往返兩城。
shuttle passengers: Free buses shuttle passengers between the airport and the downtown hotels every twenty minutes, day and night.
免費巴士日夜每二十分鐘在機場和市區飯店之間接駁乘客。
shuttle diplomacy: After weeks of shuttle diplomacy, flying back and forth between the two countries, the minister finally ended the conflict.
經過幾週的穿梭外交，在兩國之間來回飛行，這位部長終於結束了衝突。
a shuttle bus: The hotel offers a shuttle bus that takes guests to the train station for free every hour.
這間飯店提供接駁車，每小時免費載送房客到火車站。
sign a contract: Before you sign a contract with your name, you should read every line carefully, especially the small print.
在你簽名簽約之前，應該仔細閱讀每一行，尤其是小字的部分。
sign up for: If you want to sign up for the summer cooking class, you must fill out the online form before Friday.
如果你想報名暑期烹飪課，你必須在星期五前填寫線上表格。
sign in: All visitors must sign in at the front desk and write down their names before entering the building.
所有訪客在進入大樓前都必須在櫃台簽到並寫下他們的名字。
sign off: The radio host likes to sign off each night by thanking listeners and wishing them sweet dreams.
這位電台主持人每晚喜歡以感謝聽眾、祝他們好夢來結束節目。
sign away one's rights: Do not sign away your rights to the house until a lawyer has explained the papers to you.
在律師向你解釋文件內容之前，不要簽字放棄你對這棟房子的權利。
sign a player: The team paid ten million dollars to sign a player from Japan on a three-year contract.
這支球隊付了一千萬美元，以三年合約簽下一名來自日本的球員。
sign language: My cousin cannot hear, so our whole family learned sign language to talk with him at dinner.
我的表弟聽不見，所以我們全家都學了手語，好在晚餐時和他聊天。
signal a change: The dark clouds and cold wind signal a change in the weather, so you had better bring a jacket.
烏雲和冷風預示天氣將有改變，所以你最好帶件外套。
signal the end of: The ringing of the school bell is used to signal the end of each class period.
學校的鐘聲被用來標誌每一節課的結束。
signal for help: The lost hikers waved their bright red jackets to signal for help when they saw a helicopter above them.
迷路的登山客看到頭頂上的直升機時，揮動他們鮮紅色的外套來求救。
signal one's intention: Drivers should use their lights to signal their intention to turn left or right before they change lanes.
駕駛人在變換車道前，應該使用方向燈表明他們要左轉或右轉的意圖。
signal the start: A loud gunshot will signal the start of the race, and all the runners will dash forward.
一聲響亮的槍聲將宣告比賽開始，所有跑者都會向前衝刺。
sink into depression: After losing his job and his home, he began to sink into depression and refused to see his friends.
失去工作和房子後，他開始陷入憂鬱，拒絕和朋友見面。
sink money into: My uncle decided to sink money into a small coffee shop, hoping it would bring him a steady income.
我叔叔決定投入資金到一家小咖啡店，希望它能帶給他穩定的收入。
sink or swim: New employees at this company are given little training, so they must sink or swim on their own.
這家公司的新員工幾乎沒有受訓，所以他們必須成敗自負，靠自己撐下去。
sink to a new low: Sales of DVDs continue to fall, and experts expect them to sink to a new low this year.
DVD 的銷量持續下降，專家預計今年將跌到新低。
sink one's teeth into: The young writer was excited to sink her teeth into her first big project at the magazine.
這位年輕作家很興奮能全心投入她在雜誌社的第一個大型企畫。
sink a ship: During the war, a single torpedo from a submarine was enough to sink a ship of that size.
在戰爭期間，潛水艇發射的一枚魚雷就足以擊沉那種大小的船。
